“让一让让一让”
人来人往的城门处，一名十几岁的少年灵活的穿梭在人流之中，不时还伸手拨开身前来不及避让的行人，口中大声嚷嚷着从城门处一冲而过。
“要死啊，跑这么快”
“不长眼睛的小混蛋你给老子站住”
“我的菜啊！”
“对不住了各位，今天有急事先走一步，他日再登门道歉。”
少年头也不回的向后面摆了摆手，在城门守卫有些戏谑的目光中跑向了城外的树林。
“大哥，怎么办，这小子出城了可就不好抓了？”
后面，一群身着褐色短衣的汉子在城门处停下了脚步，看着跑出城门的少年身影，面上满是气愤以及不甘。
“你们两个回去禀报门主，就说那小子出城了，剩下的人跟我一起去追。”
为首的汉子挥手下达了命令，随即便带着人向着城外追了过去。
“艹，真是日了狗了，这么死咬着不放。”
树林边缘，回头看了眼城门处追来的几人，少年骂了一句，返身窜进了林子里。
少年名为隋缘，在平川城西北角的破庙里被一个老乞丐抚养长大，三年前老乞丐被冻死在一个冬天，自此小少年便成了一个不知父母为谁的孤儿，整日里在平川城内的大街小巷上游逛，过着有上顿没下顿的日子。
今日，小乞丐不知道怎么得罪了平川城内数一数二的大势力长刀门，被人一直追到了城外还不罢休。
城门处的守卫们看着一前一后的两拨人进入了树林，丝毫没有要做些什么的意思，对他们而言，只要不在城门处闹事，其他一切都好说，而且无论这少年还是后面追出来的长刀门的这些人，都算不上什么良善之人，这些人多死一些才好。
平川城长刀门所在，门主赵如安正负手在门前，看着面前中堂上悬挂的大幅下山虎画像，心中却不似面上那么平静。
作为长刀门第三代门主，在他十几年的经营下，长刀门从平川城内一个二流势力成为如今制定规矩的“三家”
之一，而且随着门中年轻一代开始成长起来，上有他这个平川城第一高手坐镇，下面年轻一辈又是高手辈出，长刀门隐隐有成为平川城第一势力的趋势，门派声望在平川城周围也是逐日高涨。

随着门派势力逐渐增强，赵如安的野心也逐渐的显露了出来，三个月前他带着两个儿子去给五音亭的二长老祝寿，没想到自己的二儿子被二长老门下的弟子看中，这让赵如安看到了机会，五音亭作为整个大梁江湖上为首的五大势力之一，只要长刀门能和五音亭搭上关系，之后的发展定然是一飞冲天，到时莫说是一个小小的平川城，就算是东海郡也将有长刀门的一席之地。
想法虽然很美好，但在实行的过程中总会出现很多的意外，为了求娶五音亭二长老的弟子，长刀门最近几乎可以说是倾尽了所有来置办聘礼，眼看着送聘的日子就要到了，最重要的那件聘礼也在今天运到了平川城，谁想到在自己的老巢内居然有人敢动平川门的东西，虽然最后聘礼是被一个不知道从哪里冒出来的小乞丐捡走了，但这件事本身却是令赵如安气愤不已。
“鲸蛟会和如意门那里有消息吗？”
眯眼看着面前的下山虎，赵如安突然开口问道。
“没有，”
站在门口的一名灰衣中年汉子沉声道，“大公子亲自带人盯着那两家，从今天早上开始两家的人都没有出过门。”
“哼，”
赵如安闻言冷笑了一声，“若非心里面没有鬼，怎么光天化日连门都不敢出了？”
“要不要今夜我带人去拜访下两家的人？”
门口的中年汉子沉声道，汉子命为赵二，是长刀门上任门主从外面捡来的孤儿，也是目前长刀门内实力仅次于赵如安的人。
“先不急，”
赵如安摇了摇头，“眼下找到那样东西才是首要的，至于鲸蛟会和如意门，且先让他们苟活两天。”
“门主，”
赵如安声音落地，门外有人近前禀报道，“那小乞丐已经从北门那里逃出城了，张统领正在带人追捕。”
声音传出，赵如安的双眼陡然眯了起来。
“门主，”
门口的赵二上前抱拳道，“城北树林后面就是小青山，张山他们人手不够，一旦让那小乞丐逃进了小青山，想要再找到可就难了。”
赵如安闻言沉吟了片刻，抬眼看向门口的赵二，“你现在带人前去增援，无论如何都要把东西带回来。”
“是。”
赵二闻言抱拳离去，赵如安来到门口，抬眼看向开始西斜的落日，负在身后的双拳紧握了起来。

城外，树林中。

"Give one, give one, give one"
At the city gate where people were coming and going, a teenage boy nimbly shuttled among the crowds. From time to time he would reach out to push away pedestrians who had no time to avoid him, and rushed past the city gate while shouting loudly.
"I'm going to die, running so fast"
"You little bastard without eyes, stop right here."
"My food!"
"I'm sorry, everyone. If there's an emergency today, please take the first step. I'll come and apologize later."
The young man waved his hands behind him without looking back, and ran towards the woods outside the city under the teasing eyes of the city gate guards.
"Brother, what should I do? Is it difficult to catch this kid if he leaves the city?"
Behind them, a group of men in brown shorts stopped at the city gate and looked at the young man running out of the city gate, their faces full of anger and unwillingness.
"You two go back and report to the sect leader that the boy has left the city, and the rest of you will chase him with me."
The leading man waved his hand and gave the order, and then led the men in pursuit outside the city.
"Fuck, what a shame, you're so stubborn and won't let go."
At the edge of the woods, he looked back at the people chasing after him at the city gate. The young man cursed and ran back into the woods.
The boy's name is Sui Yuan, and he was raised by an old beggar in a ruined temple in the northwest corner of Pingchuan City. The old beggar froze to death in the winter three years ago. Since then, the young boy has become an orphan who does not know who his parents are. He wanders around the streets and alleys of Pingchuan City all day long, living a life without a meal.
Today, for some reason, the little beggar offended the Changdaomen, one of the most powerful forces in Pingchuan City, and was chased to the outside of the city without stopping.
The guards at the city gate watched the two groups of people entering the woods, one after the other, with no intention of doing anything. For them, as long as they did not cause trouble at the city gate, everything else was fine. Moreover, neither this young man nor the people from the Changdao Gate who were chasing after him were considered good people. It would be better if more of these people died.
Where the Changdao Gate of Pingchuan City is located, the gate owner Zhao Ruan is holding his hands in front of the door, looking at the large portrait of a descending tiger hanging in the middle hall in front of him, but his heart is not as calm as he looks.
As the third generation owner of the Changdao Sect, under his more than ten years of management, the Changdao Sect has grown from a second-rate force in Pingchuan City to one of the "three families" that sets the rules today.
One, and as the younger generation in the sect began to grow up, with him as the number one master in Pingchuan City sitting in charge, and the younger generation below with masters emerging in large numbers, the Changdao Sect had a faint tendency to become the number one force in Pingchuan City, and the reputation of the sect was rising day by day around Pingchuan City.
As the power of the sect gradually increased, Zhao Ruan's ambition gradually became apparent. Three months ago, he took his two sons to celebrate the birthday of the second elder of Wuyinting. Unexpectedly, his second son was spotted by a disciple of the second elder. This made Zhao Ruan see an opportunity. Wuyinting is one of the five major forces in the entire Daliang Jianghu. As long as Changdaomen can establish a relationship with Wuyinting, its future development will definitely skyrocket. By then, let alone a small Pingchuan City, even Donghai County will have a place for Changdaomen.
Although the idea is very beautiful, there will always be many surprises during the implementation process. In order to marry the disciple of the second elder of Wuyinting, the Changdao Sect has spent almost all its money on buying betrothal gifts recently. Seeing that the day of sending out the betrothal is coming, the most important thing is The betrothal gift was also delivered to Pingchuan City today. Who would have thought that someone in his hometown would dare to touch the things at Pingchuan Gate. Although the betrothal gift was picked up by a beggar who appeared out of nowhere, the incident itself made Zhao Ruan extremely angry.
"Is there any news from the Whale Dragon Society and Ruyimen?"
Squinting at Xia Shanhu in front of him, Zhao Ruan suddenly asked.
"No,"
A middle-aged man in gray clothes standing at the door said in a deep voice, "The eldest son personally led people to keep an eye on those two families.No one from the two families has been out since this morning. "
“哼，”
Zhao Ruan sneered when he heard this, "If you don't have a ghost in your heart, why don't you dare to go out in broad daylight? "
“How about I take someone to visit the next two families tonight? "
The middle-aged man at the door said in a deep voice, his name was Zhao Er, he was an orphan picked up from outside by the previous master of the Changdao Sect, and he was currently the second most powerful person in the Changdao Sect second only to Zhao Ruan.
“先不急，”
Zhao Ruan shook his head, "Finding such a thing is the first priority right now. As for the Whale Dragon Society and Ruyi Sect, let them survive for two days first. "
“门主，”
Zhao Ru'an's voice fell, and someone outside the door came forward to report, "The little beggar has escaped from the city through the north gate, and Commander Zhang is leading people to hunt him down. "
When the voice came out, Zhao Ruan's eyes suddenly narrowed.
“门主，”
Zhao Er at the door stepped forward and clasped his fists and said, "Behind the woods in the north of the city is Xiao Qingshan. Zhang Shan and the others don't have enough manpower. Once the little beggar escapes into Xiao Qingshan, it will be difficult to find him again. "
Zhao Ru'an pondered for a moment after hearing the words, then raised his eyes to look at Zhao Er at the door, "Now you bring people to reinforce, and you must bring things back no matter what. "
"yes. "
Zhao Er heard this and left with his fists clasped. Zhao Ruan came to the door, raised his eyes to look at the setting sun that was beginning to set to the west, and clenched his fists behind him.
城外，树林中。
